title: Fine needle biopsy
description: Fine needle biopsy is a procedure where your doctor uses a thin needle to extract a small tissue sample from a suspicious lesion or lump for examination under a microscope. This helps diagnose whether the lesion is benign or cancerous. Your pathologist examines the cells to determine diagnosis. This type of procedure can be performed various ways, including non-guided fna and image-guided fna, and the cost may vary depending on the specific approach or service provided.
